name: OpenVibe.Search

exposure.note: public search page and query API at search.openvibe.network (since 2026-09-23)

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the database and dependencies are what ready checks)

drains: outbox prune timer and key refresh stopped
open HTTP connections closed, then the server
shutdown.note: the forced exit after 10 s exits 1

resumes.what: unsent events in the outbox table go to OpenVibe.Events once the relay starts (at least once; Events dedupes by event_id)
the purger resumes the cdn_purges rows still pending; the removals feed stays readable by products
OpenVibe.Events redelivers *.index_document.upserted and *.index_document.deleted that were pending during the stop (at least once, deduped by event_id)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart (30 s in host.example.json); manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: the schema code only adds (CREATE … IF NOT EXISTS, ADD COLUMN; no DROP, RENAME or table rebuild), which an older release ignores

leases.none: no claims: one process owns search.db (better-sqlite3, single writer)

notes: Canonical index document (search.index-document@1), event-fed and direct indexing with revision ordering and tombstones, permission-aware query over SQLite FTS5 (docs/adr-engine.md). Anonymous queries need no token.
